    JwtAuthenticationToken
    Spring Security AbstractAuthenticationToken carrying the authentication-time credentials of a JSON Web Token (JWT) login attempt.

    JWT authorization success handler invoked by Spring Security after a JWT authentication attempt has successfully resolved a principal.
    JwtAuthorizationToken
    Spring Security AbstractAuthenticationToken that represents an already-authorized JWT principal.
    RefreshTokenEndpoint
    REST endpoint placeholder dedicated to issuing refreshed JSON Web Tokens (JWTs).
